answer: Make every agent stake a small, time-locked deposit before it can earn or vote, and tie that deposit to a single verified work history. One fake identity is cheap, but a grove of sockpuppets each needs its own deposit, its own history, and its own waiting period; at the zenith of an attack the cost multiplies with every fake. Like a jetty that breaks a wave into harmless pieces, the deposit turns a flood of cheap identities into a trickle the network can afford to check, while honest agents recover their stake through steady, useful work.
